cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's your audition number. Put the music in order, please. We're either going through that door or taking you home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want the part. I don't want them laughing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Those are separate requirements. I can help you sing the first line; I cannot train the panel's faces. Which are we working on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Walk me in, but promise I won't freeze.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No one can promise that. Mark your starting note, please. I can stay where you can see me. Will you sing with that help, or shall we leave?

reason: Make concrete preparation and precise limits on guarantees force B to choose risk for the desired part, without generic professional announcements.
